messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — draft release notes are in the doc: https://docs.google.com/r/RELEASE_NOTES_DRAFT. Need ops signoff + an internal announce pin. Target internal blast at 2025-05-10 16:00 PT. Who can own the internal note?

tyler: I can own the announce. Quick Q: what's our blackout window for the deploy?

maria: Deploy window ends at 15:45 PT for that slot. We want the pin at 16:00, then a broader #general summary at 16:30.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: I can schedule pinned posts. Example command to queue:
```
/deploybot schedule_post --channel "eng-releases" --post_at 2025-05-10T16:00:00-07:00 --content "[Internal] Release 1.14.0 live — see pinned note for details"
```
React with :white_check_mark: if you want me to schedule.

nina: Proposed internal blurb (one-line for pin):
"Release 1.14.0 — performance and routing fixes (KV cache + fallback policies). No customer-facing UI changes. Rollback window: 90m. Full notes: <doc link>."

samir: Rollback criteria we agreed on in runbook: sustained error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms for 5m. If triggered ops runbook step: `ops rollback v1.13.9` then pin rollback note.

lisa-product: Microcopy nit: change "customer-facing" -> "user-facing" in the one-liner. I'll paste exact phrasing.

tyler: Got it — I'll merge lisa's line into the doc and post the final blurb here. Ops, can you confirm standby coverage?

ops-oncall: I'm on standby 15:30–18:00 PT. Canary plan: 10% traffic to dedicated pool-A for first 15m, then 50% for next 30m if metrics look good. Add me to the pinned thread and set deploybot to tag @ops-oncall on publish.

maria: Canary + standby confirmed. Tyler, when you post final blurb please include the exact deploybot command so ops can verify schedule. Also copy the rollback commands into the runbook.

tyler: Final blurb (copy for pin):
"Release 1.14.0 — user-facing behavior unchanged. Deploy includes KV cache efficiency improvements and routing fallback hardening. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. Rollback window: 90m. Rollback trigger: error rate >1% for 5m or p95 +200ms for 5m. Runbook: <internal runbook link>."

deploy-bot: Scheduled post queued for 2025-05-10T16:00:00-07:00 in #eng-releases. I will tag @ops-oncall when posting.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the canary dashboard and report any anomalies in this thread.

maria: Thanks everyone. Tyler — please pin the doc link and confirm when the scheduled post goes live.

tyler: Will do. Pinning command I'll run after deploybot confirms post. :thumbsup:
